title: Compare capture to reference before claiming visual parity
summary: Before claiming a screen is done, fixed, or at parity with a concept/mockup plate, capture the current app screenshot and compare it to the reference image the operator assigned. Build/compile success alone is not visual proof.
rationale: Operator repeatedly caught agents declaring Meet/auth parity while convergence pattern and layout still diverged from concept plates.
situation: Agents marked screens pass without side-by-side reference comparison.
evidence: Cursor prompt 2026-07-09: check screenshot vs concept before claiming done
